[[File:Air orb detail.png|left|150px]]
An '''air orb''' is a glass orb that has been charged at the [[Obelisk of Air]] by using the [[Charge Air Orb]] spell, requiring 66 [[Magic]], on the obelisk. The spell requires an [[unpowered orb]], 30 [[air rune]]s, and 3 [[cosmic rune]]s, yielding 76 Magic [[experience]]. The Air Obelisk is located in level 7 [[Wilderness]], north of [[Edgeville]]. To get there, climb the ladder north of the [[black demon]]s in [[Edgeville Dungeon]].

An air orb can be used on a [[battlestaff]], requiring 66 [[Crafting]], yielding an [[air battlestaff]] and 137.5 Crafting experience. Charging air orbs is also a [[Wilderness Diary#Hard|hard Wilderness Diary]] task.
